title: Smart Mart 34-Table Master Architecture ERD (4K UHD 100% Full Attributes Orthogonal)
code:
@startuml
!theme plain
scale 3840 width
hide circle
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam nodesep 24
skinparam ranksep 28
skinparam roundcorner 4
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName "Segoe UI"
skinparam defaultFontSize 11

skinparam class {
    BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
    BorderColor #1E293B
    BorderThickness 1.5
    ArrowColor #1E293B
    ArrowThickness 2.0
    FontColor #0F172A
    FontSize 12
    FontStyle bold
    HeaderBackgroundColor #F1F5F9
    AttributeFontColor #1E293B
    AttributeFontSize 10.5
}

' ============================================================
' 1. TÀI KHOẢN, KHÁCH HÀNG & SỨC KHỎE (CUSTOMER & HEALTH)
' ============================================================
entity "ACCOUNT" as ACCOUNT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **AccountID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Username : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> PasswordHash : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Email : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FullName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Role : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "MEMBER" as MEMBER {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MemberID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AccountID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FullName : string
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> FaceVector : string
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> SpendingLimit : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TotalPoints : int
}

entity "MEMBERSHIP" as MEMBERSHIP {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MembershipID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MemberID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TierName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "HEALTH_TAG" as HEALTH_TAG {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **HealthTagID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TagName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TagType : string
}

entity "MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE" as MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MemberID** : int <<PK,FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **HealthTagID** : int <<PK,FK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> status : string
}

entity "MEMBER_NOTIFICATION" as MEMBER_NOTIFICATION {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **NotificationID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MemberID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> NotifType : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Title : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> IsRead : boolean
}

' ============================================================
' 2. GIỎ HÀNG, HÓA ĐƠN & MÓN ĂN (ORDERS & CONSUMPTION)
' ============================================================
entity "CART" as CART {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **CartID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MemberID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> CreatedAt : datetime
}

entity "CART_ITEM" as CART_ITEM {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **CartItemID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> CartID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Quantity : int
}

entity "INVOICE_HISTORY" as INVOICE_HISTORY {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **InvoiceHistoryID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MemberID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> PurchaseDate : datetime
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TotalPrice : decimal
}

entity "INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM" as INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **InvoiceHistoryItemID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> InvoiceHistoryID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Quantity : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> UnitPrice : decimal
}

entity "MEAL_SUGGESTION" as MEAL_SUGGESTION {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MealSuggestionID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MealName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Calories : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> healthy_score : int
}

entity "MEAL_ITEM" as MEAL_ITEM {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MealSuggestionID** : int <<PK,FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ProductID** : int <<PK,FK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> QuantityRequired : decimal
}

' ============================================================
' 3. SẢN PHẨM & DANH MỤC (CORE PRODUCT CATALOG)
' ============================================================
entity "CATEGORY" as CATEGORY {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **CategoryID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> CategoryName : string
}

entity "SUBCATEGORY" as SUBCATEGORY {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **SubcategoryID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> CategoryID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> SubcategoryName : string
}

entity "PRODUCT_TYPE" as PRODUCT_TYPE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ProductTypeID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> SubcategoryID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> TypeName : string
}

entity "PRODUCT" as PRODUCT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ProductID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductTypeID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> UnitPrice : decimal
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> PromotionPrice : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG" as PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ProductID** : int <<PK,FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **HealthTagID** : int <<PK,FK>>
}

' ============================================================
' 4. SƠ ĐỒ SIÊU THỊ & KỆ HÀNG (STORE LAYOUT)
' ============================================================
entity "FLOOR" as FLOOR {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **FloorID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FloorNumber : int
}

entity "ZONE" as ZONE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ZoneID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FloorID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ZoneName : string
}

entity "AISLE" as AISLE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **AisleID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ZoneID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AisleCode : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AisleName : string
}

entity "SHELF" as SHELF {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ShelfID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AisleID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> LevelNumber : int
}

entity "SLOT" as SLOT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **SlotID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ShelfID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> SlotCode : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Quantity : int
}

entity "PRODUCT_SLOT" as PRODUCT_SLOT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ProductsSlotID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> SlotID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
}

' ============================================================
' 5. BẢN ĐỒ SLAM, ĐIỀU HƯỚNG & ROBOT (SLAM & ROBOTICS)
' ============================================================
entity "MAP" as MAP {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **MapID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FloorID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MapName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MapData : string
}

entity "NAVIGATION_NODE" as NAVIGATION_NODE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **NodeID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MapID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> NodeName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> XCoord : float
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> YCoord : float
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> NodeType : string
}

entity "NAVIGATION_EDGE" as NAVIGATION_EDGE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **EdgeID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> FromNodeID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ToNodeID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Distance : float
}

entity "ROBOT" as ROBOT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **RobotID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> RobotName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> RobotCode : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> BatteryPct : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Mode : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "ROBOT_LOG" as ROBOT_LOG {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **LogID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> RobotID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Battery : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Location : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "AISLE_SCAN" as AISLE_SCAN {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ScanID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AisleID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> RobotID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> EmptyPercentage : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> DensityPercentage : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> NeedsRestock : boolean
}

entity "SEMANTIC_OBJECT" as SEMANTIC_OBJECT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ObjectID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> MapID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ObjectType : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Label : string
}

' ============================================================
' 6. THƯƠNG HIỆU & QUẢNG CÁO (BRAND & MARKETING)
' ============================================================
entity "BRAND" as BRAND {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **BrandID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> BrandName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> IsSystemBrand : boolean
}

entity "AD_PACKAGE" as AD_PACKAGE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **PackageID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> PackageName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Budget : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ZoneFee : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ShelfFee : decimal
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> DurationDays : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "AD_CAMPAIGN" as AD_CAMPAIGN {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **AdCampaignID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> PackageID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> BrandID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> SemanticObjectID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> CampaignName : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> StartDate : datetime
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> EndDate : datetime
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "AD_RESOURCE" as AD_RESOURCE {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **ResourceID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AdCampaignID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ResourceType : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ResourceURL : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Status : string
}

entity "SPONSORED_PRODUCT" as SPONSORED_PRODUCT {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **SponsoredID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AdCampaignID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> Priority : int
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> status : string
}

entity "AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG" as AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG {
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> <&key> **LogID** : int <<PK>>
    --
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> AdCampaignID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ActionType : string
    <color:#0F172A>●</color> ChargedAmount : decimal
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> ProductID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> RobotID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> ZoneID : int <<FK>>
    <color:#94A3B8>○</color> MemberID : int <<FK>>
}

' ============================================================
' RELATIONSHIPS (MANHATTAN ORTHOGONAL 90°)
' ============================================================
ACCOUNT ||--o| MEMBER
MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERSHIP
MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE
HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE
MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBER_NOTIFICATION

MEMBER ||--o{ CART
CART ||--o{ CART_ITEM
MEMBER ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY
INVOICE_HISTORY ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM
MEAL_SUGGESTION ||--o{ MEAL_ITEM

CATEGORY ||--o{ SUBCATEGORY
SUBCATEGORY ||--o{ PRODUCT_TYPE
PRODUCT_TYPE ||--o{ PRODUCT
PRODUCT ||--o{ PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG
HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG
PRODUCT ||--o{ CART_ITEM
PRODUCT ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM
PRODUCT ||--o{ MEAL_ITEM

FLOOR ||--o{ ZONE
ZONE ||--o{ AISLE
AISLE ||--o{ SHELF
SHELF ||--o{ SLOT
SLOT ||--o{ PRODUCT_SLOT
PRODUCT ||--o{ PRODUCT_SLOT

FLOOR ||--o{ MAP
MAP ||--o{ NAVIGATION_NODE
NAVIGATION_NODE ||--o{ NAVIGATION_EDGE
MAP ||--o{ SEMANTIC_OBJECT
PRODUCT ||--o{ SEMANTIC_OBJECT
ROBOT ||--o{ ROBOT_LOG
ROBOT ||--o{ AISLE_SCAN
AISLE ||--o{ AISLE_SCAN

BRAND ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN
AD_PACKAGE ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN
SEMANTIC_OBJECT ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN
AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_RESOURCE
AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ SPONSORED_PRODUCT
PRODUCT ||--o{ SPONSORED_PRODUCT
AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG

' Layout Anchor: Force Store Layout, SLAM, and Ads to form Row 2 below Row 1
MEMBER -[hidden]down-> FLOOR
INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM -[hidden]down-> MAP
PRODUCT -[hidden]down-> BRAND

@enduml
